milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The allium is placed at spawn-relative [0, 0, 3] (just inside the entrance). The player must navigate close to it and face it to demonstrate they have found it. Max distance of 5 blocks and 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the flower.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The acacia slab path runs from spawn-relative [-2,-1,4] to [2,-1,9], centered at [0,-1,6]. The player must be near the path and looking toward it. A wider facing tolerance of 90° is used since the slabs form a floor path (player may look down at them from various angles).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The sticky piston is placed at spawn-relative [2, 0, 9] (right side of the path, just before the door). The player must navigate to it and face it. Max distance of 5 blocks and 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the piston.

Uses position_inside_box because the oak door at spawn-relative [0,0,10] separates the front room from the back room. Since voxel checks cannot detect door open/closed state and use_item may not fire for door interactions, the most reliable check is whether the player has passed through the door into the back room (z=11 to z=16). The player can only reach this area by opening the door. The box covers the back room area generously.
